source.initial_intent: Create a commercially compelling concept hero and an actual VULCA product-evidence sequence for the BP from one source-safe beauty launch task.
conversation_signals: images must support the commercial story rather than decorate it
enterprise scenario and investor readability come first
do not claim an unverified beauty customer case
actual VULCA evidence and GPT Image 2 concept imagery must have separate roles

avoid_cliches: dragons, lanterns, porcelain patterns, or red-and-gold decoration used as generic Chinese shorthand
Union Jack or London landmarks used as generic British shorthand
humanoid robots, glowing brains, neon circuitry, or floating AI dashboards
fake luxury logos or close imitation of a known beauty brand
risk_flags: beauty is a demonstration market, not a confirmed customer case
concept imagery can be mistaken for product proof unless labelled
tiny workflow screenshots will recreate the current deck weakness
culture cues can become decorative stereotypes instead of business-relevant localization

composition: clear negative space for deck typography
single reading path from enterprise input to adopted result
color: VULCA cobalt blue for workflow and control
material: crisp masks and layer boundaries only in evidence views
typography: deck typography added outside generated pixels
short bilingual technical labels only where necessary
aesthetic.symbol_strategy: Use visual state changes, masks, protected regions, version chips, and adoption states as evidence symbols; avoid decorative AI iconography.

commercial_context.audience: enterprise buyers, industrial partners, and early-stage investors at an AI Agent event
commercial_context.channel: six-slide 16:9 business-plan presentation and exported PDF
commercial_context.brand_maturity: early company with runnable product foundations but unvalidated commercial beauty traction
